items.title: Enrich renderEvidenceStaleHint with a done_prepare one-step line + a drift-classification line
items.context: packages/main/src/core/evidence-stale-hint.ts renderEvidenceStaleHint: keep the existing stable lines (the EVIDENCE STALE marker + Meaning + `lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=...` + `lattice validate --story=... --json`). ADD (a) a drift-classification line: whole-tree materialHash drift with UNCHANGED story-owned files (storyFilesHash) is usually unrelated/main drift -> refresh, do not re-review; storyFilesHash change = story-owned drift -> re-review/re-quorum; and (b) a one-step recovery line: `lattice done_prepare --storyId=... --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate` for TEST->DONE convergence. The three consuming surfaces (handlers/hints.ts, handlers/session.ts, handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts) call the shared renderer and auto-inherit; do not edit them unless they reconstruct the string. Keep storyId-substitution (no literal <storyId> placeholders, per B-a2f1 preMortem #3).
